text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
Her magical energy truly is incomparable...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
く……！
やはり、

text_block_list.name: Omniscient Kaiser
text_block_list.text:
Know your place!
Know despair!
And... kneel to your god!
text_block_list.orig_text:
諦めなさい！
絶望しなさい！
そして──
跪きなさい！
